title: FlapLab Daily — Matt Is Back And Now He Flies
story: You are Matt. Wii Boxing champion 2006, Swordplay champion 2009, and as of this week a canon Legend in Nintendo Switch Sports Resort. Losing was never on the menu, so you took the Island Flyover plane: hold to fly over Wuhu Island and dodge the 100-pin bowling pins with that smug face.
inspiration: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort launched 22 Oct 2026 on Switch 2 with Wuhu Island back, and players found Wii Sports Matt returning as a Legend Mii (X posts: Poofesure 2112978589306306584 on Mii sportsmates, 21 Oct; 'Wii Sports Matt being a legend is now canon' 2113374501702435107, 22 Oct; gamedeckgg 2113759873267818983, 23 Oct). Matt Mii render, Wii Sports Resort bowling-pin model and Island Flyover screenshot via MiiWiki. Fly mode = Island Flyover.
